3D Christmas Card Maker 2026 support

Choose a scene using the scene name at the top of the editor. Use Greeting to change the candle greeting in Cottage or the main text in the other scenes. Use Add text to place another line, and Decorations in the forest scenes to show or hide available extras.

Save or share a card

In the Premium edition, choose Image for a PNG still or Video for an MP4. For video, choose a bundled carol in Music or select No music. On iPhone, iPad and Windows, Choose a file… lets you add your own track. Use music you have permission to include in the cards you share.

  • iPhone and iPad · After export, choose Save to Photos or Share. If saving to Photos fails, check that the app has permission to add photos and videos, or use Share to choose another destination.
  • Android · Choose Save to Gallery or Share. Look for saved cards in the Christmas Card Maker album under Pictures or Movies.
  • Windows · Choose a folder and filename in the Save dialog. After export, Show in folder takes you to the saved file.

After an image export on iPhone, iPad or Android, you can view the result as a 3D postcard. Choose Flat image for a straight-on view or Back to editor to keep editing.

If an export fails, check your available storage and try again. On mobile, keep the app in the foreground until the export finishes.

Contact support

Email Timo at tsaari42@gmail.com. Include your device model, operating system version, app version, steps to reproduce the issue, and any error message. For an export problem, include the scene and whether you chose Image or Video.

If support asks for a diagnostic log, review it for personal details before sending it. Look for the latest card-maker-*.log in these locations.

Platform Log folder
Windows (MSIX) %LOCALAPPDATA%\Packages\<package family>\LocalState\logs. If you need the package family name, contact support with how you installed the app.
Windows (unpackaged) %APPDATA%\Islefire\Christmas Card Maker\logs
iPhone and iPad Library/Application Support/Islefire/Christmas Card Maker/logs in the app container. Contact support for help if you cannot access the container.
Android files/logs in the app’s private storage. If the folder is inaccessible, send the details above and any visible error message.
